content:
Hannah: Cookie exchange? small batch, label allergens, leave in kitchen A by Friday 4pm. winner gets a 'Best Cookie' ribbon (digital) :cookie:
Omar: yes! i'll bring my questionable but loved peanut butter blossoms. will label peanuts. :peanuts:
Keiko: i can do gluten-free ginger spiced biscuits. remote folks can mail in a small tin and photos. #remote-friendly
Zoe: fun. tiny contest categories: Most Creative, Best Presentation, Best Flavor. voting via reactions. judges: Keiko + Omar for 'Most Creative'.
cookie-bot: Reminder: Cookie Exchange drop-off deadline 2026-12-18 16:00 PT. React with :white_check_mark: to RSVP.
Hannah: RSVP'd ✅ will make a small batch of shortbread with citrus zest. pic: https://files.redwood.example/cookie-hannah.jpg
Omar: posted pic: https://files.redwood.example/cookie-omar.jpg caption: "peanut butter + chocolate center" #allergies: peanuts
Keiko: posted pic: https://files.redwood.example/cookie-keiko.jpg caption: "gluten-free ginger stars" #gluten-free
Zoe: remote entry photo: https://files.redwood.example/cookie-zoe.jpg caption: "rolled in crushed candy cane" #remote-friendly
Hannah: also small ledger: leave a Post-it with ingredients and your name. we'll tally reactions and announce winners Monday.
Omar: reaction plan: :1st_place_medal: best flavor, :sparkles: most creative, :star: presentation. people’s choice wins via emoji.
Keiko: judges note: will pick 'Most Creative' by Sunday noon. reacting now.
cookie-bot: Poll created: People’s Choice ends 2026-12-18 18:00 PT.
Zoe: caption add: "brought for code-review stamina" :cookie::computer:
Hannah: last call to RSVP, will post winners in announcements channel Monday. bring napkins. :)
